statement: A pass evaluates a policy at most once for all the bindings of one document that reach it, and a policy attached twice once: so a policy costs a pass at most one evaluation per document that binds it, and one for the attachments. The decision and the statement and binding it reports are those of evaluating every binding: the first one in candidate order reports the match or records the error.
